g.text: Acquiring both sides of downstream recovery boundaries
6 fixed initial states | 18 initial + 144 shared candidate branches | 3 seeds | no warning-model training
Bands/dots: all three seeds. Boundaries concern one-hour reserve recovery within each state’s own +5% business budget; not new safety limits.
